# 1.3-beta

- Initial Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge release of **Saphyra Reborn** (ported with full feature parity from `1.3`):
  - Reworked combat AI, phase transitions, and custom pixel-art emissive visual effects across all four bosses (**Saphyra**, **Ivory Devil**, **Nameless**, and **Puppet of Yiva Nemor**).
  - Includes all `1.3` Boss head-tracking and multi-turn rotation animation fixes.
  - Added active and passive weapon abilities with custom slash/rune/burst VFX across mod weapons.
  - Added see-through story container, target block, and key-lock highlights, plus optional **Jade** right-click item hints.
  - Built-in player keyframe animation runtime (no external Player Animator dependency required) and configurable Boss stats/mechanics via `saphyra_reborn-common.toml`.

# 1.3-beta

- **Saphyra Reborn** 首个 Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge 测试版（与 `1.3` 完整特性同步）：
  - 完整包含四大 Boss（**萨菲拉**、**象牙恶魔**、**无名**、**伊瓦·内莫尔的傀儡**）的重做战斗 AI、二阶段机制与自定义像素画发光技能特效。
  - 包含 `1.3` 全部 Boss 头部动画追踪与多圈旋转回绕修复。
  - 包含专属武器的主动/被动技能与刀光、符文法阵发光特效。
  - 包含剧情容器、目标交互方块与钥匙门锁透视高亮提示，以及可选 **Jade** 右键物品联动提示。
  - 内置玩家关键帧动画运行时（无需额外安装 Player Animator 前置），支持通过 `saphyra_reborn-common.toml` 自定义 Boss 属性与阶段参数。
